text: The customer reported that their speaker (Order LM-48870) arrived with a cracked cover and requested a refund. The previous agent initially approved a full refund of ₹3,499, then retracted the approval after reviewing the photos, noting the box had been opened and the unit was used. Instead, the agent offered a free replacement cover, which the customer reluctantly accepted. The next step is to process and ship the replacement cover for Order LM-48870.
